headline: US plans to blacklist Singapore AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia spy scandal
label: NEWS
caption:
US officials are moving hard against a major tech firm over security fears 🚨

According to the BBC, the US Department of Commerce announced plans to add Singapore based Megaspeed Ltd to a trade blacklist on Monday. 

The company faces accusations of funneling advanced Nvidia AI computer chips to China.

Increased scrutiny followed a recent scandal involving a former Megaspeed executive who was accused of working as a spy for China while having a romantic relationship with Nvidia head Jensen Huang.
